notes.title: Launch Day!!
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who supported me during greenlight, I am proud to say Pooper Scooper has officially launched. I hope to work with all my players to improve the game and make it as fun as possible. For now, enjoy some good old fashioned couch multiplayer chaos! I hope Pooper Scooper is everything you hoped for and more! I had a ton of fun making the game and I hope to continue to expand as time goes on.

If anyone encounters any issues or has suggestions please feel free to contact me at absentmoonstudios@gmail.com
